comments.text:
SVD file parsing, listing, import, and export logic (~300 lines) lives in integral-cli/src/main.rs but has no CLI-specific dependencies. Move to integral-core (or a new integral-svd crate) with a clean API:
- SvdCatalog struct: load from file, list entries, read/write entries
- CLI becomes a thin wrapper calling the catalog API

AUDIT: 'All that SVD file support logic should be in a separate crate'

title: refactor(cli): extract SVD operations into integral-core or dedicated crate
